sentences.text: The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 15-04-2016.
At the time of marriage, the accused have demanded and taken gold ornaments weighting 350 grams as dowry from the complainant and her family.

After marriage, the accused have subjected CW 1 to mental and physical cruelty by suspecting her character, insulting her in the presence of others, abusing her in filthy language, threatened to kill her and assaulted her with belt and wooden stick, quarreling with her for giving birth to a female child.
When CW-1 asked money to run the house, the accused have quarreled with her and stated to get the money from her parents to maintain the house and demanded additional dowry.

On 03-03- 2024 the accused have quarreled with CW-1, assaulted her with his hands, abused her in filthy language and pushed her to the ground, causing injuries to CW-1 and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case  3  C.C.No.35716/2024 in Cr.No.61/2024 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi South Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 to P.3 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the  4  C.C.No.35716/2024 accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
 6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and assaulted, abused and threatened her and thereby  accused have committed the offences punishable  U/s.498A, 323, 504, 506 of IPC. & Sec,3 & 4 of Dowry  Prohibition Act. ?
 2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

sentences.text: . POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex
. P.1 to Ex.P3 documents
. Ex.P1 is the first information  5  C.C.No.35716/2024 statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
Ex. P.3 is the further statement of complainant.
10 . CW-11 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Ruksar Banu.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 15-04-2016 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and deposed accused did not abused, assaulted or threatened her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2(a)
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

4  C.C.No.35716/2024  11.

entities.text: Smt Ruksar Banu vs Imran Khan Soudager
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 323, 504, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
